a: JagX knowledge packs now exceed 140 files spanning engineering, math, Nigeria, and ops.
Common questions hit local packs first for near-instant responses.
Open-ended reasoning and multi-step math use the cloud LLM when available.
Share tiered API keys; keep admin secret private.
Keep the service warm with scheduled /health pings on free Render.
If a Groq model 404s, switch GROQ_MODEL to a model your account can access.
Use /debug/status and /debug/llm to diagnose provider failures quickly.
Keep adding knowledge_packN.json files; the loader picks them up on restart.
JagX prioritizes text and coding help for builders.
